facts.statement: The October 2011 webcast was to include a recap of recent Farming updates in Free Realms.
facts.quote: They’ll also give us a recap on some Farming updates

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: This official SOE news post announces a Free Realms webcast (Thursday, October 6, 2011, 4:00 p.m. US Pacific, streamed on the Stickam SOE channel, about 20 minutes) previewing the Spooktacular event, Farming updates, and the new mini-game "Spot the Difference". It is a schedule announcement and gives no mechanics, rewards or item details.
